description: This file provides support utilities for WebSocket testing within the GatewayWebSocket component, including mock implementations of WebSocket tasks and sessions, and helper functions for constructing WebSocket messages and responses used in testing the GatewayWebSocket functionality.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking that simulates WebSocket client behavior for testing, supporting hooks for send and receive operations.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session managing multiple WebSocket task instances for testing.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: A test extension method to simulate sending a ping, kept simple for unit test resilience.
